meta.title: Best Offer duration can be set in minutes, hours or days

steps.note: Open a suitable existing event where a Best Offer request can be initiated.

args.goal: open the Request for Best Offer panel, enter a duration in minutes and verify the resulting window, then change the unit to hours and verify it, then change the unit to days and verify that each resulting window matches the entered duration

steps.note: Perform and verify the panel's minute, hour, and day duration behavior directly on screen.
Confirm the completed duration-unit checks did not produce an application error.
